facts.fact: The joint UPR submission says the Freedom of Information Act was operationalised through implementing regulations, citing the Freedom of Information (General) Regulations 2021, SI 229 of 2021; the document is dated July 2026 and the regulations' year is 2021.
The submission treats the Freedom of Information Act 2020 as law in operation, with regulations made under it, and recommends fully implementing it; the Act is dated 2020 by its citation.

systems.system: Freedom of Information (General) Regulations 2021, SI 229 of 2021
